_meta.note: Reward values are ILLUSTRATIVE, taken from the research docs. Verify against current MOENV / 7-Eleven / FamilyMart policy before real use.

battery_recycling.display_name: Battery recycling at a convenience store

safety_checks.fail_message: Lithium/button-cell terminals must be taped before disposal to prevent short circuits.

reject_if.message: Swollen or leaking batteries are rejected — hand these directly to public cleaning squads.

battery_recycling.educational: Bring dry batteries to any 7-Eleven / FamilyMart counter — roughly NT$11 discount per 0.5 kg. Tape lithium and button-cell terminals first.

reject_if.message: Rinse the bottle and remove the cap/label before recycling — food/liquid residue lowers recycled value.

pet_bottle_recycling.educational: Empty, rinse, and flatten PET bottles. Caps go with plastics too. Clean bottles keep recycling value high.

paper_container_css.display_name: Paper container — Clean, Sort, Stack (清、分、疊)

reject_if.message: Paper containers must be wiped/rinsed clean (清). Heavy oil or food residue means rejection.

paper_container_css.educational: Paper meal boxes are PE-lined, not normal paper. Clean (清) → Sort with other containers (分) → Stack to reduce volume (疊).

reusable_cup.display_name: Reusable cup at a drink shop
reusable_cup.educational: Bringing your own cup earns a legally-mandated NT$5+ discount (since July 2022) plus bonus Green Points for skipping single-use plastic.
